# askdare

> `@boldare/askdare` adds an AI chatbot to any website. A Next.js 16 app (App Router, Node.js runtime) serves the chat from one catch-all route; other sites embed it with one `<script>` tag. Built on the official `openai` SDK (Responses and Conversations APIs); no database.

Set it up with `npx @boldare/askdare init` and verify it with `npx @boldare/askdare doctor`. The public API is `defineBot` (which returns a `BotHandle`), `defineTool`, `defineTheme`, `turnstile` and `ERROR_CODES` from `@boldare/askdare`; `createChatHandler` (with `onError`, `onUsage` and `onFeedback`) and `getChatConfig` from `@boldare/askdare/next`; `Root`, `DefaultChat`, the hooks and the primitives (including `Disclosure` and `HumanCheck`) from `@boldare/askdare/react`; the CLI commands (`init`, `doctor`, `kb sync`, `add ui`); `upstashStore` from `@boldare/askdare-upstash` and `otelUsage` from `@boldare/askdare-otel`; the `data-*` attributes of the script tag, `askdare(…)` on the page, the `--ask-*` CSS tokens, the `data-ask-part` names and the text keys. Everything else is internal.

## Docs

- [Getting started](docs/getting-started.md): install, `init`, `.env.local`, `doctor`, embedding on other sites
- [Configuration](docs/configuration.md): every `defineBot` and `createChatHandler` option, limits with defaults, the human check (`security.humanVerifier: turnstile({ siteKey })`, `TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY`), `limits.requireSharedStore`, environment variables
- [Embedding](docs/embedding.md): the script tag and its `data-*` attributes, several bots, the host page's CSP, your own page in the widget's iframe (`embedPath`, `EmbedRoot`, `embedPageHeaders`), staging and production
- [CLI](docs/cli.md): `init`, `doctor` (including model shutdown dates and bots with the AI notice off), `kb sync`, `add ui` and `usage`, with every flag
- [Troubleshooting](docs/troubleshooting.md): symptoms, causes and fixes, by error code (`ERROR_CODES`)
- [Tools](docs/tools.md): `defineTool`, Zod schemas, what a tool may trust, and `ui`: what the visitor sees of a result as a card
- [Reply options](docs/reply-options.md): clickable answers under the latest reply, suggested by the model (`widget.replies: 'suggest'`) or defined by a tool (`defineTool({ replies })`), limits, placement, cost
- [Signed-in visitors](docs/identity.md): `askdare('identify')`, IDENTITY_SECRET, `context.identity`
- [Knowledge base](docs/knowledge-base.md): `npx @boldare/askdare kb sync`, vector stores, citations
- [Attachments](docs/attachments.md): images and PDFs from visitors
- [Voice input](docs/voice-input.md): dictation and its limits
- [Styling](docs/styling.md): texts, languages, AI disclosure, custom CSS and the `data-ask-part` names, `askdare('open' | 'configure')`, inline mode
- [React](docs/react.md): the chat inside a page of your own app with `@boldare/askdare/react`: `getChatConfig`, `Root`, `DefaultChat`, hooks and primitives, tool cards (`toolRenderers`, `ToolResults`, `Link`), the AI notice in your own markup (`Disclosure`), the human check (`HumanCheck`), CSS resets, CSP, `add ui`
- [Texts](docs/texts.md): every text key with its default in each built-in language (en, cs, de, es, fr, it, pl), plurals, adding a language, switching the chat's language on the page (`askdare('configure', { locale })`, `data-follow-lang`)
- [Themes](docs/themes.md): Halo, Aura, Sage and Care, tokens and variants
- [Deployment](docs/deployment.md): Vercel, Heroku, proxies, shared limits
- [Going public](docs/going-public.md): OpenAI project, secrets, limits, privacy checklist
- [Guardrails](docs/guardrails.md): opt-in OpenAI moderation (`moderation`), your own `onInput` and `onOutput` rules to allow, block or redact, answers held back while they are checked, `toolResults: 'untrusted'`
- [Costs](docs/costs.md): the worst case under the default limits, and how to keep it bounded
- [Observability](docs/observability.md): `onUsage` and `onError`, cost per turn, OpenTelemetry spans with `@boldare/askdare-otel`
- [Chat events](docs/events.md): what the chat reports to the page, for analytics
- [Answer ratings](docs/feedback.md): 👍/👎 with an optional comment, `onFeedback`, what the report holds
- [Privacy](docs/privacy.md): what is stored where and sent to whom (OpenAI, its moderation endpoint, Cloudflare for the human check), for your privacy policy
- [Compliance](docs/compliance.md): AI Act disclosure (`widget.disclosure`, the `Disclosure` primitive), GDPR (DPA, retention, deletion), data residency, the resume token in inline mode, hosts other than Vercel and Heroku, no Edge runtime
- [Accessibility](docs/accessibility.md): the WCAG 2.2 AA conformance statement: scope, how it is tested, finished answers announced to screen readers, focus kept in a full-screen chat, known limitations
- [Support](docs/support.md): Node.js (22, 24 and 26), Next.js, React, zod and TypeScript versions, browsers, sizes
- [Migrating from @boldare/openai-assistant](docs/migrating-from-openai-assistant.md): what maps to what

## Optional

- [Streaming protocol](docs/protocol.md): the SSE events between the server and the chat, endpoints and status codes
- [Custom stores](docs/custom-store.md): writing your own store for limits and budgets, or for conversations
